definitions.explanation: The outermost surface of the earth. Used in geography, science, and general descriptions of things on or near the ground level.

examples.japanese: {地表|ちひょう}の{温度|おんど}が{上昇|じょうしょう}した。
{雨水|あまみず}が{地表|ちひょう}を{流|なが}れていく。
examples.english: Rainwater flows across the ground surface.

examples.japanese: {地表|ちひょう}から{数|すう}メートルの{深|ふか}さに{遺跡|いせき}が{発見|はっけん}された。
examples.english: Ruins were discovered at a depth of several meters from the surface.

notes:
{地表|ちひょう} combines {地|ち} (earth/ground) and {表|ひょう} (surface).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地表|ちひょう}{温度|おんど} — ground surface temperature
- {地表|ちひょう}に{近|ちか}い — near the surface
- {地表|ちひょう}{付近|ふきん} — vicinity of the surface

RELATED WORDS:
- {地下|ちか} — underground
- {地中|ちちゅう} — in the ground
- {海面|かいめん} — sea surface
- {地表面|ちひょうめん} — ground surface (more technical synonym)
